E0312

Value `==` unsupported (field detail)

What

Value `==` unsupported (field detail)

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0312

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0312: tests/ui/auto_derive_opt_out_use.stderr.

Error [E0112]: `print` doesn't know how to show `NoPrint`
  --> tests/ui/auto_derive_opt_out_use.jet:11:11
    |
 11 |     print(NoPrint{ value: 1 })
    |           ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: print shows values that have a display
 Fix: print one of its parts instead
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0112

Error [E0112]: `NoDebug` can't be shown with :Debug yet
  --> tests/ui/auto_derive_opt_out_use.jet:12:13
    |
 12 |     print("{NoDebug{ value: 2 }:Debug}")
    |             ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: debug interpolation needs a debuggable value
 Fix: implement `Debug` or use a debuggable part
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0112

Error [E0312]: `NoEquality` doesn't support `==`
  --> tests/ui/auto_derive_opt_out_use.jet:13:11
    |
 13 |     print(NoEquality{ value: 3 } == NoEquality{ value: 3 })
    |           ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: value equality requires the Equatable trait
 Fix: add `#Equatable` before the type, implement `Equatable` by hand, or compare individual fields
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0312
